name: Johnson Furniture Company
old_description: Johnson Furniture has been serving the River Region for more than 60 years and is proud to be furnishing the homes of the fifth generation of many of our loyal customers. We take pride in selling quality name brand furniture at tremendous savings with FREE delivery.
about:
Johnson Furniture Company operates showrooms in Eclectic and Greenville, Alabama, and has served the River Region for more than 60 years. The business began as a local furniture retailer and has grown to serve multiple generations of area families.

The retailer carries a range of name-brand furniture and accessories from manufacturers such as Ashley Furniture, Best Home Furnishings, Bradington Young, Craftmaster, England, Fairfield, Forty West, Hammary, Hooker, Jamison Bedding, Kincaid, Surya Rugs, Uttermost, and Winston Furniture. It offers in-stock merchandise and special orders, with free delivery on all purchases. Experienced interior designers assist customers with fabric and style selections across traditional, transitional, rustic, and contemporary aesthetics. The company also maintains an online collection for remote shopping.

Johnson Furniture primarily serves residential customers looking to furnish their homes, including multi-generational families in the River Region. Its showrooms provide a hands-on experience, while special-order capabilities allow for customized configurations.

The company emphasizes free delivery and personalized design assistance as key differentiators, aiming to help customers complete the look they envision for their homes.
